params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an ability, {{ci|Taric}} empowers his next two basic attacks to gain tremendous {{sti|as|{{as|'''total''' attack speed}}}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on {{as|his '''bonus''' armor}}, and {{sti|cdr|reduce}} the cooldowns of his basic abilities.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Taric''' empowers his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} within 5 seconds to each gain {{sti|as|{{as|100% '''total''' attack speed}}}}, deal {{as|{{pp|25 + (93-25)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-attack}}, and reduce the {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldowns}} of his basic abilities by {{pp|1;( 1 + ( ( x * 10 ) / ( ( x * 10 ) + 100 ) ) );2|0;10 to 100 for 10;∞|label1= AH|type=ability haste|formula= 1 + ( Haste / ( Haste + 100 ) )}}
 seconds.
params.notes:
* The first attack refreshes ''Bravado's'' duration.
* Subsequent ability casts will refresh the duration and grant another empowered attack if '''Taric''' has one attack remaining.
** ''Bravado'' may only grant up to two empowered attacks.
* The bonus damage will not apply against {{tip|structures}}.
* ''Bravado's'' damage can be {{tip|dodged}} and {{tip|blocked}} but it cannot ''miss'' if '''Taric''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}. The cooldown reduction still applies when {{tip|blind|blinded}}, however it does not apply on {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blocked}} ''Bravado'' attacks.

blurb.plain: Innate: After casting an ability, Taric empowers his next two basic attacks to gain tremendous total attack speed, deal bonus magic damage based on his bonus armor, and reduce the cooldowns of his basic abilities.

description.plain:
Innate: After casting an ability, Taric empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to each gain 100% total attack speed, deal ⟦pp⟧ (+ 15% bonus armor) bonus magic damage on-attack, and reduce the remaining cooldowns of his basic abilities by ⟦pp⟧
 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Taric}} {{tip|heal|heals}} himself and nearby allied champions based on {{as|his '''maximum''' health}} per charge of ''Starlight's Touch'' that he periodically [[ammunition|stocks]], up to a cap. ''{{ai|Bravado|Taric}}''-empowered attacks each grant one charge.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' {{tip|heals}} himself and nearby allied champions for {{as|25|heal}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% of his '''maximum''' health)}} per charge of ''Starlight's Touch'' that he periodically [[ammunition|stocks]], up to a maximum amount. ''{{ais|Bravado|Taric}}'' empowered attacks each grant one charge.
params.description2: ''Starlight's Touch'' can heal up to a maximum of {{as|125|heal}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}} {{as|(+ 5% of '''Taric's''' '''maximum''' health)}} at 5 charges.
params.notes:
* ''Starlight's Touch'' works on {{tip|untargetable}} allies.
* The healing will apply heal effects (such as {{ri|Summon Aery}}) prioritizing targets in '''Taric's''' circle, based on proximity to him, then in the {{ai|Bastion|Taric|Bastioned}} ally's circle, based on proximity to that ally (including it).

blurb.plain: Active: Taric heals himself and nearby allied champions based on his maximum health per charge of Starlight's Touch that he periodically stocks, up to a cap. Bravado-empowered attacks each grant one charge.

description.plain: Active: Taric heals himself and nearby allied champions for 25 (+ 15% AP) (+ 1% of his maximum health) per charge of Starlight's Touch that he periodically stocks, up to a maximum amount. Bravado empowered attacks each grant one charge.

description2.plain: Starlight's Touch can heal up to a maximum of 125 (+ 75% AP) (+ 5% of Taric's maximum health) at 5 charges.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Taric}} gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and forms a {{tip|tether}} to the ally bound by ''Bastion''. While the tether persists, the ally gains the {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and '''Taric's''' abilities are mimicked to them.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' {{tip|shields}} himself and the target allied champion for a short time, with the amount based on each {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}. He also binds them with ''Bastion''.
params.blurb4: Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Taric''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and forms a {{tip|tether}} between him and the ally bound by ''Bastion''. While the tether persists, the ally also gains the {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and '''Taric's''' abilities are mimicked to them, though the effects do not stack.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' grants himself and the target allied champion a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, binding them with ''Bastion''.
params.description3: '''Taric''' can also [[self-targeted|self-cast]] to shield himself; if he self-casts and is untethered, he will become tethered to the nearest ally. Similarly, if he is tethered to an ally and self-casts, both he and the ally will be shielded. Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.
params.notes:
* The mimicked abilities will still complete even if '''Taric''' dies or leaves range.
* Abilities are not mimicked to the bound ally if they are {{tip|vanish|vanished}} via {{ai|Alpha Strike|Master Yi}}, {{ai|Hallucinate|Shaco}}, {{ai|Rappel|Elise}}, or {{ai|Void Rush|Rek'Sai}}.
** Mimicked abilities will also cancel if they vanish as above.
* ''Bastion'' effects will be temporarily disabled while the bound ally is in a different realm than '''Taric''' ({{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|Death Realm}}). The tether will not break.
* ''Bastion'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.

blurb.plain: Passive: Taric gains bonus armor and forms a tether to the ally bound by Bastion. While the tether persists, the ally gains the bonus armor and Taric's abilities are mimicked to them.

blurb2.plain: Active: Taric shields himself and the target allied champion for a short time, with the amount based on each target's maximum health. He also binds them with Bastion.

blurb3.plain: Taric can also self-cast to shield himself.

blurb4.plain: Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.

description.plain: Passive: Taric gains bonus armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by Bastion. While the tether persists, the ally also gains the bonus armor and Taric's abilities are mimicked to them, though the effects do not stack.

description2.plain: Active: Taric grants himself and the target allied champion a shield for 2.5 seconds, binding them with Bastion.

description3.plain: Taric can also self-cast to shield himself; if he self-casts and is untethered, he will become tethered to the nearest ally. Similarly, if he is tethered to an ally and self-casts, both he and the ally will be shielded. Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Taric}} winds up over a brief moment, then projects a beam of starlight in the target direction that briefly {{tip|stuns}} enemies hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} based on his {{as|'''bonus''' armor}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' winds up over 1 second, granting {{tip|ghosting}} to nearby units, then projects a beam of starlight in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stuns}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.notes:
* ''Dazzle'' casts work even if the tethered ally is {{tip|untargetable}}.
* ''Dazzle'' will aim towards the target direction on-cast when firing from both his and his {{ai|Bastion 2|Taric|Bastion's}} positions.

blurb.plain: Active: Taric winds up over a brief moment, then projects a beam of starlight in the target direction that briefly stuns enemies hit, dealing magic damage based on his bonus armor.

description.plain: Active: Taric winds up over 1 second, granting ghosting to nearby units, then projects a beam of starlight in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and stuns them for 1.5 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Taric}} calls down a star that descends to him over a short time. Afterwards, he and nearby allied champions become {{tip|invulnerable}} for a short time.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taric''' calls down a star from above that descends to him over {{fd|2.5}} seconds. Afterwards, he and nearby allied champions become {{tip|invulnerable}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

blurb.plain: Active: Taric calls down a star that descends to him over a short time. Afterwards, he and nearby allied champions become invulnerable for a short time.

description.plain: Active: Taric calls down a star from above that descends to him over 2.5 seconds. Afterwards, he and nearby allied champions become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds.
